summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new Santé du code (admin /admin/code-health) cards: 'Lignes par domaine (sous-modules)' on the Metrics tab and 'Couverture réelle par domaine' on the Coverage tab. Logged in as admin@superapp.com, both cards render correctly with the expected data-testids and contents. No console or page errors.

test_results.metrics_tab_card_code-health-domains: PASS - heading 'Lignes par domaine (sous-modules)' present, 8 domain rows rendered
test_results.coverage_real_card: Shows 23.3% (7076/30429 lines, 145 tests passed / 87 failed, sample run finished 14/06/2026 07:22:41)
test_results.coverage_by_domain_card_present_on_load: PASS - data-testid='coverage-by-domain' rendered immediately because previous run was 'done'
test_results.tab_switch_back_to_metrics: PASS - domains card still visible, no crash

critical_code_review_comments: AdminCodeHealth.js is 546 lines and contains 4 tab components inline; splitting MetricsTab/CoverageTab/SecurityTab/MapsTab into separate files would improve maintainability (file approaches the 700-line guideline).
CoverageTab does not surface fetch errors for codeCoverageByDomain (silent .catch(() => {})) — if the endpoint ever returns 500, the user only sees the card missing with no toast/feedback.

Domain bar uses raw d.domain (containing '/') in the data-testid, which is fine for selectors but unusual; current implementation works (verified 'domain-routes/market' and 'cov-domain-routes/market' resolve).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new cards on /admin/code-health work end-to-end. Coverage data is persistent because a previous pytest --cov run completed; if backend is restarted and last_run resets, the 'coverage-by-domain' card will only appear after a fresh run finishes (status 'done'). Tests used real admin login and the production REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
